sources.title: Gemma3 implementation at configured version
sources.evidence: Defines all text/vision/projector module relationships and dense gated MLP/GQA/RMSNorm parameters. Checkpoint key conversion preserves legacy saved names. LM head is a tied weight; embedding scale and rotary frequencies are nonpersistent buffers absent from saved tensors.

sources.title: Gemma3 configuration defaults
sources.evidence: Gemma 3TextConfig defaults tie_word_embeddings=true when absent from exact checkpoint config. Confirms dense model construction from text and SigLIP configs.

sources.title: Transformers embedding tying implementation
sources.evidence: tie_embeddings_and_encoder_decoder reads text config tie_word_embeddings; _tie_or_clone_weights assigns output_embeddings.weight=input_embeddings.weight unless TorchScript. Exact checkpoint uses standard tied weights; no TorchScript override.

sources.title: SigLIP vision implementation
sources.evidence: Defines learned convolution/position embeddings, biased attention and MLP matrices, layer norms and optional pooling head. No pooling head when exact config vision_use_head=false; position_ids nonpersistent buffer. Every saved vision tensor maps to a learned parameter.

sources.title: Pinned chat template

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 4B inferred through the explicit NVIDIA Gemma-3-4B-it fine-tune lineage. Qwen Team Table 7 reports Gemma-3-4B Base at 4B activated; Google identifies PT-to-IT post-training, and exact PT/IT/NVIDIA aggregate totals plus the checked NVIDIA/base architecture match. No structural resizing, pruning, expert expansion or added modality was found. Teacher-generated reasoning traces train the named Gemma student and do not transfer Qwen3-32B size. Kimi Team Figure 1 independently corroborates roughly 4B for exact Gemma-3-4B-IT. This is an attributed nominal research-comparison convention, not a direct NVIDIA/Google active disclosure or exact per-token census. NVIDIA documents text moderation while retaining vision weights; the comparisons do not establish Gemma-specific component or phase counts. Fresh card, Build/API, deployment, linked research and targeted primary searches found no more precise exact-fine-tune active definition.

architecture.note: Dense Gemma 3 causal decoder with34 layers(29 sliding, five full), GQA and gated MLP; released checkpoint retains27-layer SigLIP vision encoder and projector. No routed experts. Decoder generates labels and optional traces through tied language head.

parameter_count_reproduction.method: Fetch 8-byte safetensors header lengths and exact JSON headers using HTTP 206 ranges; validate exact key sets against index, all BF16shapes, contiguous offsets and total file sizes. Reconstruct all 884expected saved shapes from exact configuration and Transformers 4.57.1 constructors. Config default and loader tie input/output matrices; deduct one671252480element duplicate. Three 64-byte pairs at start/middle/end agree as a limited consistency check; no full weight payload downloaded.
parameter_count_reproduction.buffer_handling: Gemma embedding scale/rotary frequencies and SigLIP position IDs are nonpersistent and absent. All 884saved keys map to nn.Parameter; no quantization scales or packed storage. Tied duplicate is learned storage but adds no independent parameters.

summary: Parameter re-audit retains the precise 4.300079472B total, freshly confirmed by NVIDIA index and aggregate metadata, and establishes nominal 4B active through explicit Gemma 3 4B PT-to-IT-to-NVIDIA fine-tune lineage under Qwen Team's comparison convention, corroborated by Kimi Team's exact IT plot. Matching architecture and totals support unchanged model structure. Text-only documented moderation and retained vision weights remain distinct; exact component/phase activity is unresolved. Other 12 field assessments and prior tensor-reproduction evidence are preserved; no shards were requested in this pass.
